resources.string: Save the keys of your encrypted chats to a file protected with a passphrase, or load such a file — for example after reinstalling without a key backup.
Anyone with this file and its passphrase can read your encrypted chats. Choose a long passphrase (several words) and keep the file somewhere safe. The passphrase cannot be recovered.
Weak: easy to guess. Use several words.
Fair. A longer passphrase is safer.
No encrypted chats are loaded yet: all keys this device has are exported.
Not saved: no file was chosen.
Too many keys for one file. Export the chats one by one (untick “All encrypted chats”).
Choose a key file exported from dur.io or another Matrix app and enter its passphrase. Keys you already have are kept; messages waiting for these keys become readable.
%1$d keys of rooms from other apps were left out.
Messages read with imported keys are marked “sender not confirmed”: a file cannot prove who wrote them.
Wrong passphrase, or the file was modified.
This is not a key file, or it is damaged.
The file is too large (more than 64 MiB).
The file could not be read or written.
